Subject: Discovery recap — schedule ML/Infra technical runthrough (60–90m)

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical runthrough with our ML/Infra team.

Recap (from our call)
- Objective: validate production feasibility for your real-time recommendation use case and get alignment on latency / cost tradeoffs.
- Key concerns you raised: peak throughput spikes, inference cost per 1M requests, and secure VPC connectivity.
- Success criteria for the runthrough: short POC checklist (throughput target >= 500 req/s, P95 latency < 120ms at target batch size, plan for prefix caching).

Recommended next step
I'd like to schedule a 60–90 minute technical runthrough (ML + Infra + Eng owners) where we:
1) review current architecture and key traces (5–10m)
2) runtime and serving model options (quantization, batching, KV cache) — owner: Marissa (20–30m)
3) deployment & networking (VPC, IAM, KMS) — owner: Vivek (15–20m)
4) SLOs, autoscaling and fallback policies (10–15m)
5) open Q&A + next actions (10–15m)

Proposed 60–90m slots (PDT) — pick one or propose alternatives:
- Tue Jun 1: 10:00–11:30am PDT
- Wed Jun 2: 2:00–3:30pm PDT
- Thu Jun 3: 9:00–10:30am PDT

Ask: please confirm which slot works, who from your side will attend (ML, infra, procurement if needed), and whether you want an initial agenda PDF or a short pre-read. If you can share a small sample trace (anonymized) ahead of time that would help Marissa prepare.

Attachments: initial-architecture.png (reference diagram)

Thanks — I’ll have Marissa and Vivek on the invite once you confirm.

—Karthik
